tools.name: get_pool_info
tools.description: Get comprehensive information about an Ekubo pool including current price, liquidity, and fee data.

assetType.description: The type of the asset concerned by the allowance: SYMBOL or ADDRESS

assetValue.description: The symbol (e.g., "ETH", "USDC") or the contract address of the token

token0.description: The asset information (symbol or contract address) of the first token in the pool

assetType.description: The type of the asset concerned by the allowance: SYMBOL or ADDRESS

assetValue.description: The symbol (e.g., "ETH", "USDC") or the contract address of the token

token1.description: The asset information (symbol or contract address) of the second token in the pool

fee.description: The fee tier as a percentage (e.g., 0.05 for 0.05%, 0.3 for 0.3%, 1 for 1%, defaults to 0.05)

tick_spacing.description: The tick spacing as a percentage (e.g., 0.01 for 0.01%, 0.1 for 0.1%, 1 for 1%, defaults to 0.1)

tools.name: swap
tools.description: Swap tokens on Ekubo DEX. Supports both exact input (specify input amount) and exact output (specify desired output amount) swaps with configurable slippage tolerance.

assetType.description: The type of the asset concerned by the allowance: SYMBOL or ADDRESS

assetValue.description: The symbol (e.g., "ETH", "USDC") or the contract address of the token

token_in.description: The asset information (symbol or contract address) of the token to sell

assetType.description: The type of the asset concerned by the allowance: SYMBOL or ADDRESS

assetValue.description: The symbol (e.g., "ETH", "USDC") or the contract address of the token

token_out.description: The asset information (symbol or contract address) of the token to buy

amount.description: The amount to swap (in token decimals, e.g., "1000000" for 1 USDC with 6 decimals)

is_amount_in.description: If true, amount is input token amount. If false, amount is desired output token amount

slippage_tolerance.description: Maximum slippage tolerance as a percentage (e.g., 0.5 for 0.5%, defaults to 0.5%)

fee.description: The fee tier as a percentage (e.g., 0.05 for 0.05%, 0.3 for 0.3%, 1 for 1%, defaults to 0.05)

tick_spacing.description: The tick spacing as a percentage (e.g., 0.01 for 0.01%, 0.1 for 0.1%, 1 for 1%, defaults to 0.1)

tools.name: create_position
tools.description: Create a new liquidity position (NFT) in an Ekubo pool within a specified price range (concentrated liquidity). Mints a new NFT position.

amount1.description: The amount of token1 to add (in token decimals)

assetType.description: The type of the asset concerned by the allowance: SYMBOL or ADDRESS

tick_spacing.description: The tick spacing as a percentage (e.g., 0.01 for 0.01%, 0.1 for 0.1%, 1 for 1%, defaults to 0.1)

tools.description: Withdraw liquidity from an Ekubo pool position. Can withdraw full position, partial position, or only collect fees.
